title: compress-routing-decision-paths-and-shed-legacy-regional-mappers
creator: Lena Park
description: Problem: The smart routing layer has accreted multiple legacy regional mappers, a thin policy shim, and several synchronous locks that increase tail latency and complicate fallback guarantees. This ticket scopes a safe, incremental refactor: - Consolidate the policy evaluation inputs into a single immutable DecisionContext to reduce copying and branching. - Replace three legacy regional mapper modules with a compact RegionAdapter that exposes a deterministic failover interface and explicit leases. - Simplify fallback contracts so the caller receives a small set of deterministic outcomes (PrimaryOK, FallbackOK, Throttled, Unrouteable). - Remove the global routing mutex on the hotpath by introducing an optimistic compare-and-swap reservation for route leases and falling back to an async reconciliation queue. Goals: reduce median routing decision latency by >=10% and 95th percentile by >=15%, and remove two legacy routing modules entirely. Approach: 1) Design and proto: document DecisionContext, RegionAdapter interface, and new fallback enum in the design doc (link below). 2) Implement RegionAdapter + DecisionContext in a side-by-side module behind feature flag "routing.v2". 3) Introduce compatibility shim that translates old mapper outputs to the new fallback enum. 4) Add lightweight telemetry for decision path lengths and lease contention. 5) Canary rollout: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on increased error rate or degraded latency. Rollout will use Dedicated canary pool first, then Hosted. Migration notes: - Some downstream callers expect an optional "region_hint" string; DecisionContext will preserve but will no longer mutate it. - To avoid inconsistent state during migration we'll double-write leases to both legacy store and new RegionLeaseStore for 2 weeks, then cut over reads. Risks and mitigations: - Risk: mismatch between legacy mappers and new deterministic fallback semantics. Mitigation: add a migration test harness and a compatibility mode where we log divergence but continue serving. - Risk: increased operational load from telemetry. Mitigation: sample metrics at 1/1000 on low-traffic routes for the first two weeks. Engineering trade-offs: We accepted a small complexity increase in the path that writes both stores temporarily to avoid an expensive one-time full migration. We do not attempt to change model routing decisions in this ticket; behavioral changes are limited to mechanical fallback semantics and telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: DecisionContext spec checked in to docs and reviewed by runtime and infra (design doc link)
RegionAdapter implemented and covered by unit tests with >= 90% branch coverage
Compatibility shim validated by migration harness showing <= 0.1% divergence in responses after 10k synthetic requests
Benchmarks show median decision latency improvement >= 10% and p95 >= 15% in canary environment
Canary rollout plan executed and monitored with automatic rollback thresholds configured
Old legacy mapper modules removed from tree and documented deprecation notes included
comments: 2025-02-18 Lena Park: Kickoff meeting notes posted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUNTIME/DecisionContext+and+RegionAdapter+-+RFC. Agreed scope is limited to mechanical refactor and telemetry. Diego assigned.

2025-02-22 Diego Martinez: Initial PR created with DecisionContext and RegionAdapter interfaces. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/12587. Requesting design review from @Maya and @Kenji.
2025-02-25 Maya Singh: Design review comments - prefer explicit lease expiry timestamps over heartbeats; also suggest adding an adapter test that simulates region flaps. Added to PR review.

2025-02-27 Diego Martinez: Addressed review comments; updated RegionAdapter to use expiry timestamps and added region-flap integration test. Bench harness shows preliminary median improvement ~8% on local sim, p95 improved ~12% (not yet canary).

2025-03-01 Kenji Watanabe: Security/ops review - ensure double-write to leases has idempotent semantics. Ops requested an escape hatch to disable double-write via a feature flag. Adding flag 'routing.double_write_leases'.

2025-03-03 Diego Martinez: Canary started at 1% on dedicated canary pool. Initial metrics: routing decision median delta -12%, p95 -18%, CPU on routing service -9%. No errors above baseline. Logging divergence rate 0.03% over first 10k requests. Moving to 10% after morning window.
2025-03-04 Lena Park: PM note - prioritize monitoring dashboards for rollout (add route-level charts) and coordinate with SRE for rollback runbook. Adding release to runtime-1.22.
2025-03-04 QA: Integration tests passed on canary with feature flags toggled. Noted flaky test 'region-mapper-e2e'—investigation opened as ENG-1002401.
test_plan: Unit tests for DecisionContext and RegionAdapter (edge cases, leases expiry, region flaps). Integration test that runs both legacy mapper and RegionAdapter in parallel and records divergence. Load bench: 200k synthetic requests across mixed route sizes; collect median/p95 and CPU. Canary with 1%, 10%, 50%, 100% progression and SLO alarms for 10% increased error rate or 5% regression in median latency. Post-cutover: run migration-validation job for 48h to compare metrics between stores.
